author: Medicines Optimisation / Clinical Genomics joint rule set
source: CPIC thiopurine/TPMT-NUDT15 guideline; BNF azathioprine monograph

poor_metaboliser.summary: TPMT poor metaboliser: standard thiopurine dosing risks life-threatening myelosuppression. Do not issue at standard dose. Specialist review required; if a thiopurine is essential, use drastically reduced dosing with intensive FBC monitoring.

intermediate_metaboliser.summary: TPMT intermediate metaboliser: start at 30-80% of the standard dose with FBC monitoring.

normal_metaboliser.summary: TPMT normal metaboliser: standard thiopurine dosing with routine monitoring.
